info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Campaign Execution Management API
info.description: The Campaign Execution Management API facilitates the initiation and management of sales prospect campaign executions within the banking sector. This API enables financial institutions to effectively deploy their marketing strategies by executing predefined campaigns aimed at potential customers. Typical consumers of this API include marketing departments and sales teams who utilize the functionality to trigger, monitor, and analyze the effectiveness of their campaigns. Utilize this endpoint to streamline campaign execution processes and enhance customer engagement.

post.summary: Create a new prospect campaign execution.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to initiate a new prospect campaign execution for targeted marketing efforts. Provide the necessary details for the campaign, and the system will process the execution accordingly.
